declarations.title: HarnessShell
declarations.responsibility: Keeps the console place in the browser history, address and query, when no application router does.

declarations.title: HarnessTabs
declarations.responsibility: A row of tabs: the views the console had, or the tabs of an entity it is given, each a link where it has an address.

declarations.title: HarnessUnit
declarations.responsibility: Shows one unit: its contract, owned interface, dependencies, consumers, targets, budgets and scenarios.

declarations.title: HarnessVerdict
declarations.responsibility: The binary verification badge: the green check only for a verdict that passed and the red cross for every other value, drawn as an icon alone, with its status and reasons in a tooltip that opens on hover, focus or tap.

declarations.title: HarnessScreen
declarations.responsibility: Mounts the explorer on one route page: gives the console the address of the page, the router to move with and the screen the page names, and titles the document.

declarations.title: ProjectActivity
declarations.responsibility: Lays out the activity of one repository and gives its parts one look; without live data it is a recorded history.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.reading
inputs.type: { now: number; failed: boolean; refresh: () => void }

declarations.title: Select
declarations.responsibility: The one select field of the website: a labelled native select with its caret, its size and its disabled look in one place, holding the options a surface gives it.

declarations.title: SiteActivity
declarations.responsibility: Keeps the activity of the hosting site current on an open page: it reads again and lets time pass over what it last read.

declarations.title: consoleViteConfig
declarations.responsibility: Builds the console as one script and one stylesheet for hosts that serve it themselves.

declarations.title: shellPlaywrightConfig
declarations.responsibility: Runs the browser checks of the explorer shell alone: no server, no seeded history and no build of the application.

declarations.title: shellViteConfig
declarations.responsibility: Builds one page of the shell fixture as one script and one stylesheet into the directory of the run that asked for it.

declarations.title: /api/project-activity
declarations.responsibility: Serves the activity of the repository this site is hosted for; it only reads.

declarations.title: /harness/data/[...path]
declarations.responsibility: Serves the history index and revision details to an admitted request.

declarations.title: /harness/export/[commit]
declarations.responsibility: Serves one recorded verification as a portable report to an admitted request.

declarations.title: /harness/media/[file]
declarations.responsibility: Serves one recorded media file to an admitted request.

declarations.title: hooks
declarations.responsibility: Puts every request to the owner policy before any page, API, data or media handler runs.

declarations.title: activityClient
declarations.responsibility: Reads the activity of the site again while its page is open and visible, and reports a reading that did not arrive.

declarations.title: activityDisplay
declarations.responsibility: Words, times and links the activity components share.

declarations.title: activityReading
declarations.responsibility: Says what a reading of the roster still tells at a given moment: who counts as working, and when nobody can be said to be.

declarations.title: captureProvenance
declarations.responsibility: States what really produced a recorded capture: its own build, its standing and the attempt it belongs to.

declarations.title: consoleExport
declarations.responsibility: Builds the portable report page of one recorded verification from stored JSON and media.

declarations.title: consoleServer
declarations.responsibility: Binds the local owner policy to the history directory this server was given.

declarations.title: correctedLocation
declarations.responsibility: Says where an explorer address of an entity belongs at its revision: under the category the entity has there, with its branch, commit, section and tab kept.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.at
inputs.description: The address that was asked for.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.entities
inputs.description: The entities of the shown revision, each with the category its manifest declares there.

outputs.name: correctedLocation
outputs.description: The same address under the category of the entity at this revision; null when it is already there, names no entity or the revision does not hold it.

declarations.title: e2eFixtures
declarations.responsibility: Gives each browser run a directory and ports of its own for everything it seeds, names them to its servers, seeds and specs, and removes only what that run made.

declarations.title: entityBehavior
declarations.responsibility: Arranges the headless results the host found into states with both sides, and repeats what the host concluded without concluding anything itself.

declarations.title: entityCatalog
declarations.responsibility: Turns the entities of one category into the rows of a collection with their relations and verdict, and filters and orders them as a person asked.

declarations.title: entityContract
declarations.responsibility: Reads the contract of a unit as rows of plain words for its kind, and names the states it has to be proven in.

declarations.title: entityHistory
declarations.responsibility: Decides which commits of a history are listed as changes, and reads their timings by profile, each beside the earlier value of its own series.

declarations.title: entityLens
declarations.responsibility: Declares what the host answers for the explorer content and how its components navigate, names the six collections, and builds the location of another place in the same branch and revision.

declarations.title: entityMeasure
declarations.responsibility: Reads the size and the performance profile of a unit from the record of a revision; what nothing measured is Not measured, never zero.

declarations.title: entityReasons
declarations.responsibility: Summarises the reasons one commit recorded for an entity to the length of a single reason under the shared writing limits, and keeps every original beside the summary.

outputs.name: reasonUses
outputs.type: Array<{ kind: ReasonKind; outcome: string; subjects: string[] }>

declarations.title: entityRemoved
declarations.responsibility: Names the scenarios and states the parent of a selected commit declared for an entity and the commit no longer does.

declarations.title: entityScreens
declarations.responsibility: Picks the screenshot of one state and viewport out of the evidence the host gave, one at the tip or a pair at a commit, states the gap of what has none, and turns captures into gallery items.

declarations.title: entitySearch
declarations.responsibility: Finds the entities of one revision whose names, ids, purposes or declared contract names match every word of a query, best matches first.

declarations.title: entityShown
declarations.responsibility: Works out what an overview and a details screen say about an entity: its contract, measures and judging record, and the reasons its commit recorded.

declarations.title: explorerArtifact
declarations.responsibility: Reads the bytes of one recorded artifact, checks them against the recorded hash and says what the artifact states about a run.

declarations.title: explorerBehavior
declarations.responsibility: Says from the hashes of the recorded end-to-end results of both sides which are the same bytes, which differ, and which appeared or went.

declarations.title: explorerCategory
declarations.responsibility: Says which of the six explorer categories a unit belongs to, from its kind.

declarations.title: explorerCoverage
declarations.responsibility: Judges one scenario that covers a unit against a record: its tests, its result and lineage, and every declared state, as typed standings.

declarations.title: explorerEntities
declarations.responsibility: Lists the units of a revision as explorer entities with category, name, verdict and change, and the units the shown commit removed from its first parent.

declarations.title: explorerEvidence
declarations.responsibility: Selects what an entity is shown with: the tip alone at a branch tip, or the first parent and the selected commit, with the coverage of each side and what makes the two not like for like.

declarations.title: explorerHistory
declarations.responsibility: Lists the commits that changed one entity on the ancestry of the shown commit, from the changes the history records for each commit, with their sizes and reviews.

declarations.title: explorerName
declarations.responsibility: Gives a unit the name a reader is shown: words taken from its title and id, never a path.

declarations.title: explorerReading
declarations.responsibility: Reads the recorded results of both sides of a behaviour comparison and says, from every field they hold except what a run declares about itself, whether the behaviour changed.

declarations.title: explorerRelations
declarations.responsibility: Says what an entity contains and what contains it: pages, shells, components, functions, configs and services, each in its own section.

declarations.title: explorerScope
declarations.responsibility: Resolves an explorer address against a history: the branch, its actual tip, the commit shown and that commit's first parent.

declarations.title: explorerSearchEntries
declarations.responsibility: Turns the entities the explorer shows at a commit into search entries with name, purpose and contract names; never a source path, never a removed unit.

declarations.title: explorerState
declarations.responsibility: Judges one declared state of a scenario against a record, and says which states of a scenario show a unit: those that name it, else those that name something made of it.

declarations.title: explorerVerdict
declarations.responsibility: Decides whether a unit is proven at a revision: only when every required test, state, viewport and commit-bound capture passed.

declarations.title: focusView
declarations.responsibility: Decides which part of the component map is shown and which unit an arrow key moves to.

declarations.title: frozenBuild
declarations.responsibility: Copies a finished build to where one browser run serves it from, and refuses a directory that holds no build or that changed while it was copied.

declarations.title: harnessAncestry
declarations.responsibility: Derives branches, ancestors and the default commit from the revisions an index holds.

declarations.title: harnessBudget
declarations.responsibility: Words one frozen metric of a unit at a revision: its value and limit, or that it is unavailable and not frozen, and what a partial value leaves out.

declarations.title: harnessClient
declarations.responsibility: Fetches the index and a revision detail from the protected endpoints, each once and only when asked.

declarations.title: harnessComparison
declarations.responsibility: Aligns the recorded evidence of two revisions by scenario, state and viewport into before and after pairs, naming what either side lacks.

declarations.title: harnessEmitted
declarations.responsibility: Reads the size of what a unit emits at a revision, one line for each execution target with its own bytes and its own limit, and the sizes on both sides of a comparison; a missing size is said to be missing, never shown as zero.

inputs.name: emittedChange.sides
inputs.type: Array<{ units: HarnessUnit[]; record: HarnessRecord | null }>

declarations.title: harnessEmittedGrowth
declarations.responsibility: Derives the emitted size of one unit commit by commit for each execution target, with the limit each commit was verified under and the reviews that measured it.

declarations.title: harnessEvidence
declarations.responsibility: Maps the recorded captures of one verification onto gallery items and a portable report.

declarations.title: harnessFailures
declarations.responsibility: Counts the failures of a record and groups those that say the same thing about different subjects into one cause, leaving nothing out of the count.

declarations.title: harnessGrowth
declarations.responsibility: Derives the growth steps of one unit and the commit behind each.

declarations.title: harnessIcons
declarations.responsibility: Holds the path data of the shared icon set of the explorer, which icons are solid, and the icon of each of the six categories.

declarations.title: harnessImpact
declarations.responsibility: Derives what changed between two revisions, from a record when one compared them and from the registries otherwise.

declarations.title: harnessLayout
declarations.responsibility: Places units in dependency layers so the same revision always draws the same map.

declarations.title: harnessPage
declarations.responsibility: Decides what a console path shows in a history: an explorer page bound to a branch tip or a selected commit, a redirect to one, or nothing.

declarations.title: harnessShell
declarations.responsibility: Works out what the bar of the explorer shows for an address: where the brand leads, the six categories inside the viewed branch and commit, the tip and viewed labels, and where a branch, a commit and Go to tip lead.

declarations.title: legacyEvidence
declarations.responsibility: Maps the files of a report from before Git-backed records onto gallery items, as what they are.

declarations.title: navbarSearch
declarations.responsibility: Gives the bar's search the entries of exactly the revision in view and its scope in words, and a location only for a result those entries hold.

declarations.title: portablePage
declarations.responsibility: Wraps a report whose media is inline into one self-contained page.

declarations.title: reportDestination
declarations.responsibility: Says where in the explorer an earlier report address leads: Pages at the commit the report names when this history holds it, else Pages at the branch tip.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.request
inputs.type: (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>

declarations.title: reportServerRecord
declarations.responsibility: Keeps the record a report store has of the server it started on a port, and ends exactly that process, known by its id and start time.

declarations.title: reportSite
declarations.responsibility: Fixes the application this server is hosted for when it starts, and says what belongs to it.

declarations.title: siteActivity
declarations.responsibility: Reads the activity of the application this server is hosted for, whatever a request asks.

declarations.title: siteProcesses
declarations.responsibility: Limits a CPU sample to agents working in a checkout of the hosting application, keeping the machine totals.

declarations.title: tooltipPlace
declarations.responsibility: Works out where a tooltip goes on the screen: under its mark and centred on it, kept wholly on the screen, above the mark when only there it has room, and cut to the larger side when neither has.

outputs.name: tooltipPlace
outputs.type: { left: number; top: number; height?: number }

declarations.title: ExplorerEvidence
declarations.responsibility: Describes the proof an entity is shown with: the coverage of each scenario state by state, the captures of each side, and the behaviour recorded on both sides.

declarations.title: ExplorerScreen
declarations.responsibility: Describes what the host of the explorer gives the content of a screen, and the component that takes it, without naming any renderer.

declarations.title: Explorer
declarations.responsibility: Describes what the explorer shows of a history: the scope of an address, a verdict, an entity with its relations, and the history of an entity.

declarations.title: HarnessBudget
declarations.responsibility: Describes a reviewed line of the budget ledger and the limits a revision freezes for what a unit emits, as the console reads them.

declarations.title: HarnessLegacy
declarations.responsibility: Describes a report from before Git-backed records as the history index keeps it.

declarations.title: Harness
declarations.responsibility: Describes the parts of the history index and revision details the console reads.

declarations.title: console
declarations.responsibility: Mounts the console into the document a host serves.

declarations.title: /analytics
declarations.responsibility: Redirects the former analytics address to the explorer; the console has no analytics page.

declarations.title: /harness/analytics
declarations.responsibility: Redirects the former console analytics address to the explorer.

declarations.title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components
declarations.responsibility: Shows the components of this repository at a branch tip or a selected commit, to search, order and open.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: The branch, as one encoded path segment. Its tip is shown unless a commit is named.

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: After /commit/: the selected commit, compared with its first parent. Absent, the tip is shown alone.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The components of the shown revision in a table, each with its verdict and what the commit changed, to search, order and open.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Components · Harness

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.

Redirects the root of this server to the explorer.

declarations.responsibility: Presents the report store as one site may see it: reports of another application are absent.

declarations.responsibility: Owns the build_zip build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: fake-r2
declarations.responsibility: Owns the fake-r2 build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: freeze-build
declarations.responsibility: Gives the browser run it belongs to its own checked copy of the finished build and prints where it is.

declarations.title: harness-audit
declarations.responsibility: Owns the harness-audit build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: harness-emitted-seed
declarations.responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history a unit built for two execution targets and takes it through a missing limit, a baseline, growth of one output while the other shrinks, an approval and an output that is no longer built.

declarations.title: harness-explorer-seed
declarations.responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history what the explorer acceptance needs: a page with nested components, a config, and scenarios that record screenshots and end-to-end results.

declarations.title: harness-scale-data
declarations.responsibility: Generates a registry of several hundred units to exercise the map at the size of a real repository.

declarations.title: harness-shells-seed
declarations.responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history a frame first indexed as a component and baselined, then declared a shell on its manifest alone, and a later commit no branch keeps.

declarations.title: install_screenshot_retention
declarations.responsibility: Owns the install_screenshot_retention build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: seed-e2e
declarations.responsibility: Owns the seed-e2e build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: seed-harness-console
declarations.responsibility: Builds the fixed synthetic Git history the console browser acceptance inspects.

declarations.title: seed-sites
declarations.responsibility: Creates two synthetic applications from one template, with the checkouts of the first, for the report fixtures.

declarations.title: entity
declarations.responsibility: Styles the base of the explorer content under its own root: tokens, type, cards, pills and the summary grid.

declarations.title: entity-evidence
declarations.responsibility: Styles the evidence of an entity: screenshot panes, viewport choice, end-to-end results and the artifact reader.

declarations.title: entity-history
declarations.responsibility: Styles the tables of a collection and of a history and the panel of a selected change.

declarations.title: entity-index
declarations.responsibility: Styles a collection of the explorer: its controls, the grid of page cards and the legend.

declarations.title: entity-summary
declarations.responsibility: Styles the header of an entity, its rows of facts, small tables, relation lists and scroll frames.

declarations.title: explorer
declarations.responsibility: Publishes the explorer palette and sizes on its root, re-points the colours the console reads inside it, and styles the page column, notices, cards, pills, breadcrumbs, the search field and the switch.

declarations.title: explorer-controls
declarations.responsibility: Styles the shared controls of the explorer: outlined actions, the two looks of a verdict, the tabs of an entity, and the branch and commit fields of the bar with their tip and viewed labels.

declarations.title: explorer-navbar
declarations.responsibility: Styles the bar of the explorer: brand, repository, the six categories with the gold line under the active one, and how the bar wraps on a tablet and a phone without widening the page.

declarations.title: harness
declarations.responsibility: Styles the console views in the reports design, and brings in the stylesheets of the explorer.

declarations.title: AgentRegistryRepository
declarations.responsibility: Keeps what agents state about themselves in a checkout: one registration, its latest heartbeat and its end, each written whole.

declarations.title: BudgetLedgerRepository
declarations.responsibility: Reads the budget ledger of a revision and appends reviewed events to it.

declarations.title: EvidenceBranchRepository
declarations.responsibility: Appends immutable record directories to the evidence branch and reads them back.

declarations.title: ExplanationRepository
declarations.responsibility: Stores reasons outside the source tree until they are persisted as notes.

declarations.title: HistoryNoteRepository
declarations.responsibility: Reads and appends the Harness note of a commit.

declarations.title: LegacyReportRepository
declarations.responsibility: Reads the legacy report store without writing to it.

declarations.title: MeasurementRepository
declarations.responsibility: Stores and reads kernel benchmark runs, one file per machine profile.

declarations.title: ProjectWorkRepository
declarations.responsibility: Reads from Git the checkouts of a repository, what commits changed and what is not committed in a checkout.

declarations.title: SourceHistoryRepository
declarations.responsibility: Lists the branches and commits of source history, leaving out evidence, notes and internal refs and marking commits kept only by an archive ref.

declarations.title: VerificationStoreRepository
declarations.responsibility: Stores verification drafts with their evidence until they are persisted as Git evidence.

declarations.title: build-api
declarations.responsibility: Builds the public API bundles, their declarations and the shipped kernel artifacts.

declarations.title: build-kernel
declarations.responsibility: Builds the native and Wasm kernels with the pinned toolchain and records their sizes and hashes.

declarations.title: build-picker
declarations.responsibility: Owns the build-picker build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: desktop-experiment-launcher
declarations.responsibility: Owns the desktop-experiment-launcher build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: package-reports
declarations.responsibility: Owns the package-reports build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: prepare-desktop-experiment
declarations.responsibility: Owns the prepare-desktop-experiment build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: rust
declarations.responsibility: Owns the rust build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: AgentActivityService
declarations.responsibility: Registers agents, records their heartbeats and ends, and lists the agents of a repository with whether each is working now.

declarations.title: AttachedRecordService
declarations.responsibility: Loads one attached record from Git and validates the manifest and every file it consists of.

declarations.title: BudgetService
declarations.responsibility: Derives current limits from the ledger and lineage and reports every budget failure.

inputs.name: BudgetService.evaluate.context
inputs.type: { measurements: Measurement[]; baselines: Map<string, UnitBaseline>; profile: string }

declarations.title: BuildIdentityService
declarations.responsibility: Reads a build directory and reports the identity of the files it holds.

declarations.title: CheckRunService
declarations.responsibility: Runs one planned check in the snapshot under isolation and collects what it captured.

declarations.title: CommitMessageService
declarations.responsibility: Measures commit messages of a repository against the writing limits: the staged message of a commit in the making, and the stored messages of a range of source commits, where the committed tree declares the limits.

declarations.title: ConsoleChangeService
declarations.responsibility: Classifies what an install would overwrite, saves what it replaces and records each change with its before and after identity.

declarations.title: ConsoleInstallService
declarations.responsibility: Installs the console into a SvelteKit host and records exactly which files it wrote.

declarations.title: ConsoleUninstallService
declarations.responsibility: Removes an installed console from a host, puts back what the install replaced, and never removes edited files unasked.

declarations.title: EvidenceAttachService
declarations.responsibility: Validates a verification record and its dependencies and persists them to the evidence branch, notes and archive refs.

declarations.title: EvidenceRestoreService
declarations.responsibility: Restores attached records from Git into the local cache after validating every file.

declarations.title: ExplanationService
declarations.responsibility: Matches recorded reasons to the changes that need them by exact content fingerprints.

declarations.title: HistoryIndexService
declarations.responsibility: Builds the deterministic history index from source refs, registries, notes and evidence.

declarations.title: HistoryMediaService
declarations.responsibility: Resolves the media of attached records and legacy reports into a content-addressed output directory.

declarations.title: HistoryStatusService
declarations.responsibility: Reports what Git history proves about one commit: its attached records, their validity and every problem.

declarations.title: HistorySyncService
declarations.responsibility: Fetches, merges and pushes evidence, notes and archived source refs without forcing or discarding a writer.

declarations.title: HookInstallService
declarations.responsibility: Installs, removes and reports the opt-in pre-push and commit-msg hooks, with an opt-in of its own for each stage and worktree, chaining any existing hook and restoring it byte for byte.

declarations.title: HookRunService
declarations.responsibility: Runs the pre-push gate: each pushed source commit must have a passing verification, which is then attached.

declarations.title: ImpactService
declarations.responsibility: Computes what a change affects by asking the impact kernel about the base and head graphs.

declarations.title: KernelBenchmarkService
declarations.responsibility: Measures every kernel runtime on identical workloads, cold and warm.

declarations.title: LegacyHistoryService
declarations.responsibility: Reads imported legacy reports from the evidence branch for the history index and resolves their media.

declarations.title: LegacyImportService
declarations.responsibility: Imports this repository's legacy reports into the evidence branch as recorded.

declarations.title: ProjectActivityService
declarations.responsibility: Shows the activity of the repository a checkout belongs to: recorded work from Git and, live, its checkouts and agents.

declarations.title: ReasonPathService
declarations.responsibility: Decides whether a range is explained, directly or by the reasons of every step along its first-parent history.

declarations.title: RecordAssemblyService
declarations.responsibility: Turns what a run observed into one sealed record with every gate judged.

declarations.title: RevisionDetailService
declarations.responsibility: Builds the detail of one revision: its stored registry graph, its attached records with resolved media and inherited provenance, and the reasons for what its commit itself changed.

declarations.title: RuntimeServerService
declarations.responsibility: Serves any runtime over loopback HTTP as an independently running unit.

declarations.title: SnapshotRunService
declarations.responsibility: Runs setup and every planned check inside a clean snapshot and reports mutations.

declarations.title: SourceImpactService
declarations.responsibility: Computes what a commit changed against its first parent from the two stored trees, and which of those changes need a reason, with no record or working tree involved.

declarations.title: TrustedBaseService
declarations.responsibility: Finds the nearest revision that a passing, intact verification record proves, which is the only base a verification may build on.

outputs.name: TrustedBaseService.nearestRecord
outputs.type: Promise<{ commit: string; record: string } | null>

declarations.title: UnitBenchmarkService
declarations.responsibility: Measures a unit end to end through its declared execution target.

declarations.title: UnitRuntimeService
declarations.responsibility: Turns declared execution targets into working runtimes and selects the measured kernel default.

declarations.title: VerificationService
declarations.responsibility: Verifies one exact commit: which scenarios rerun, which are inherited, and the stored record.

declarations.title: VerificationCheckService
declarations.responsibility: Decides whether a stored record proves a commit: identity, integrity and outcome.

declarations.title: VerificationGates
declarations.responsibility: Guards the registry against deleted identities and the ledger against rewriting.

declarations.title: buildHistory
declarations.responsibility: Builds the portable history index for a repository into an output directory.

declarations.title: importReports
declarations.responsibility: Imports the legacy reports of this repository from a store that is only read.

declarations.title: inspectScenarios
declarations.responsibility: Lists, shows and checks scenario contracts.

declarations.title: installConsole
declarations.responsibility: Installs the console into a host or restores a file an install replaced, and renders what changed.

declarations.title: loadRevisions
declarations.responsibility: Loads base and head revisions with their registries, graphs and source facts.

outputs.name: openRange
outputs.type: Promise<{ root: string; base: RevisionSide; head: RevisionSide }>

declarations.title: persistReasons
declarations.responsibility: Keeps the reasons of a committed range in the notes of its last commit.

inputs.name: persistReasons.options
inputs.type: { root?: string; commit?: string; base?: string }

declarations.title: runActivity
declarations.responsibility: Runs the activity commands for the checkout they are called in: show, register, heartbeat, finish and list.

declarations.title: runBudget
declarations.responsibility: Reports measurements, limits and ledger history, and benchmarks a unit.

declarations.title: runExplain
declarations.responsibility: Reports required reasons and records new ones.

outputs.name: explainReport
outputs.type: Promise<ReasonReport & { root: string; writing: WritingVersion | null }>

declarations.title: runHistory
declarations.responsibility: Attaches a stored record to Git history and reports what history proves about a commit.

declarations.title: runHooks
declarations.responsibility: Installs, removes, reports and runs the opt-in hooks of a worktree: the pre-push verification gate and the commit-msg gate that measures a commit message.

declarations.title: runImpact
declarations.responsibility: Loads two revisions and reports the impact between them.

declarations.title: runKernel
declarations.responsibility: Runs kernel parity, default selection, serving and cold sampling.

inputs.name: kernelSample.options
inputs.type: { runtime: string; nodes: number; seed: number; url?: string; }

declarations.title: runKernelBench
declarations.responsibility: Runs the kernel benchmark, derives the default and records the run.

declarations.title: runKernelBoundary
declarations.responsibility: Benchmarks the public invocation boundary of the kernel and records it as evidence.

declarations.title: runVerify
declarations.responsibility: Resolves the commit and base, runs verification and checks stored records.

declarations.title: signBudget
declarations.responsibility: Validates the reviewer and record behind a baseline or approval and writes the ledger event.

declarations.title: syncHistory
declarations.responsibility: Runs one explicit fetch, push or sync of history refs with a named remote.
